title: Time-consistency of cash-subadditive risk measures: The infimal cocycle property
abstract: arXiv:2611.34192v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We characterize the time-consistency of convex, cash-subadditive dynamic risk measures in terms of their minimal penalty. The dual variables are conditional sub-probability densities, which factorize across an intermediate date in many ways, according to how the discount is allocated to the two periods. We introduce an infimal cocycle property, in which the penalty is the infimum over all such factorizations, and show that it is equivalent to time-consistency, with the infimum attained. This holds on $L^\infty$ under continuity from below, and on $L^p$, $p<\infty$, without continuity assumptions. In the cash-additive case it reduces to the classical cocycle property. For risk measures induced by BSDEs, it represents the dynamic programming principle of a stochastic control problem whose value is the penalty.

translated_title: 现金次可加风险测度的时间一致性：下确界上循环性质
translated_abstract: 我们通过最小惩罚刻画了凸的、现金次可加动态风险测度的时间一致性。其对偶变量为条件次概率密度，这些变量可以在中间时点上以多种方式进行因子分解，具体方式取决于折现如何分配到两个时期。我们引入了下确界上循环性质，其中惩罚函数取为所有此类因子分解的下确界，并证明该性质与时间一致性等价，且下确界可以取到。该结果在 $L^\infty$ 空间上于下连续性假设下成立，而在 $L^p$（$p<\infty$）空间上则无需任何连续性假设。在现金可加情形下，该性质退化为经典的上循环性质。对于由倒向随机微分方程（BSDEs）诱导的风险测度，该性质表示以惩罚函数为价值的随机控制问题的动态规划原理。
tldr: 本文引入“下确界上循环性质”，通过最小惩罚完整刻画了现金次可加动态风险测度的时间一致性，证明该性质（且下确界可取到）与时间一致性等价，并在现金可加情形下退化为经典的上循环性质。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an infimal cocycle property of the minimal penalty that fully characterizes the time-consistency of convex cash-subadditive dynamic risk measures, reducing to the classical cocycle property in the cash-additive case and representing the dynamic programming principle for risk measures induced by BSDEs.
